description: Well locations in Cambodia (2010) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset contains information of well locations, water quality (arsenic, iron contamination.. ), drilling, digging and lithology. The well map database is an initiative of the Ministry of Rural Development of Cambodia, piloted with financial support from the Water and Sanitation Program of the World Bank, and published online in March 2010. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Development assistance for water and sanitation, Ground water, Rural water supply, Water and sanitation, Water quality testing. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, jpeg, kml, mdb, shp. The portal shows 2019-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
